notes.title: Update 0.5 "The Canyon Purge" Now Available in SCP: The Expedition
notes.notes:
Update 0.5 "The Canyon Purge" Now Available in SCP: The Expedition
We are thrilled to announce the release of update 0.5 "The Canyon Purge" for SCP: The Expedition. This update focuses on a new chilling threat from SCP-337, and the introduction of the game’s first side mission centered on eradicating these monstrous entities from the canyon. Here’s what’s new:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/41bdb8d7b7bba3167b8ee9121b3884d04066c692.gif

Main Feature - SCP-337 and the Canyon Mission: 
After dealing with the Chaos Insurgency in Act 2, the area has become infested with SCP-337! Players must take on the daunting task of defeating these monsters and destroying their spore nests to clear the canyon and restore safety to the region.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/435e4f3163cea1c2b0e8f8bfc553977af808b6ed.gif

Other Gameplay Improvements:
Automated Item Sorting: 
We’ve added a feature that automatically sorts items by their usefulness, making inventory management easier and more intuitive.

Inventory Screen Dragging Fix: 
We’ve fixed the issue where the inventory screen would move unintentionally while dragging items, ensuring a smoother interface interaction.

Modified Combat Encounter in Act 2: 
We've modified a fight to feature SCP-377, which now not only enhances the encounter but also unlocks an additional mission for players to tackle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/b7c97e35baec1aacd456dece56ec70f8abbf28c6.png

This is just the first of many side missions we are planning to introduce. We are already working on more and invite you to join our Discord server where we post the most current progress updates. 

Happy gaming and see you in the next update!

notes.title: Update 0.4 "Strategic Enhancements" Now Available in "SCP: The Expedition"
notes.notes:
Update 0.4 "Strategic Enhancements" Now Available in SCP: The Expedition

We are excited to announce the release of update 0.4 "Strategic Enhancements" for SCP: The Expedition. This update brings two significant changes aimed at improving gameplay and adding depth to combat scenarios. 

Here’s what's new:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/7acdee9dfb3c504c86763d48853690dc5773df8c.png
Improved OptimizationFollowing the changes made to the camera work, a performance drop was noted across many locations. However, with the latest fixes in the rendering of the game world, we've managed to increase performance by up to 10% during the most demanding moments! This enhancement ensures a smoother experience across all areas of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/9da4c2913b39d72f3e260711314d56ce58a38147.png
New Types of Human EnemiesWe're introducing a variety of Chaos Insurgency agents to make the battles more intriguing. In the current version of the game, you will encounter the following types of enemies: 
Chaos Operative
Chaos Grenadier
Chaos Precision Eliminator
Chaos Suicide Insurgent
Chaos Heavy Enforcer
This diversification is designed to challenge players to adapt their strategies and provides a richer combat experience.

Although the list of changes in this version is brief, we want to inform you that these implemented changes will facilitate the introduction of more enemy types in the future! We've completed the prototyping phase for SCP-337, whose prototype version can be seen in the gif below. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/7d62d3127d9430b44f4d53035652dc6d3a1387af.gif

Additionally, we're developing mechanics for other SCPs that players will be able to confront. We're not resting on our laurels and are already excitedly working on a new map and side missions. However, they will require a bit more time before they're ready. 

Happy Easter, and see you in 2 weeks with the new update!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.1 for SCP: The Expedition is now available!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the release of hotfix 0.3.1, introducing crucial improvements to SCP: The Expedition. Here's what has been addressed:

- Enhanced Mission Loading: We have increased the speed of scene loading. By optimizing the loading process during mission briefings, transitioning into action is now quicker and smoother.

- Fixed Issue with Operation Green Whisper: We've addressed a rare issue where attempting to load a game save that had already started the Operation Green Whisper mission would cause infinite loading. With this fix, the mission should now load seamlessly, allowing all players to fully enjoy the gameplay experience.

Update Size Information
We understand that the size of the latest hotfix update 0.3.1 may appear large to some players. We would like to clarify that this is due to our ongoing efforts to improve SCP: The Expedition. Currently, the game files are not fully optimized, which results in a larger update size.

However, we are aware of this issue and are actively working not only on enhancing and developing the game but also on optimizing the source code. Our goal is to make changes to the game's structure so that future updates will not require downloading such large files.

Thank you for your understanding and patience. Your support is invaluable to us and motivates us to continue our work, making SCP: The Expedition even better.

notes.title: Update 0.3 New Horizons Now Available in SCP: The Expedition!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/5a6f5dcdbf43203bd0e2b561ea67ddd80e7b5212.png
Dear explorers of the SCP Foundation mysteries, 
we're thrilled to announce the release of the latest 0.3 New Horizons update, which brings fresh changes and improvements to the world of SCP: The Expedition. Here’s what's new for you in this exciting update:

Enhanced Weapon System: Our team has worked diligently on expanding the arsenal available to your agents. With this update, we’ve introduced three new types of weapons, which not only increase your tactical possibilities but also add a new depth to combat strategies. Remember, the weapon system is still evolving, and in the near future, we will enable the upgrading of owned weapons.

Increased Character Speed: Responding to player feedback, we've increased the movement speed of your agents by 30%. Now, exploration and responses to threats will be even more dynamic and smooth.

New Animations and Camera Work: Exploration of the game world and combat have gained a new dimension with the introduction of new animations, making unit movements more realistic and dynamic. Additionally, we've revamped the camera work to better adapt to player needs:
- During exploration, the camera now defaults to a position closer to the agents, providing a better view of the surroundings.
- In combat, we added the ability to move the camera using the WASD keys, giving greater control over the battlefield.
- We also improved the smoothness of camera movement during zooming, making every detail of the game world even more visible.

Improvements and Additions: We’ve enhanced the appearance of terrains in all missions, adding new elements to discover and interesting items that will enrich your adventure. For detail lovers, we’ve also introduced the sound of Ivy's growth, as well as fixed the display of grenade descriptions and other objects.

In the coming weeks, we are not resting on our laurels! Our team is currently working on a new enemy behavior system. The aim of these changes is to introduce greater diversity into combat by adding new types of enemies. This exciting innovation will appear in the next update, scheduled for two weeks from now.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us and inspires us to continuously develop SCP: The Expedition. See you in the game!

notes.title: New Update "SCP: The Expedition" v0.2 - Steam Achievements, Bug Fixes, and More!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/83218fdcd714c597e87536dff4360190e8c81df4.png

Dear Players!

We are thrilled to announce the release of update v0.2 for our turn-based strategy game, "SCP: The Expedition". This update brings a host of changes and additions that you have been eagerly waiting for, enriching your gaming experience even further. Here are the key highlights of the update:

Steam Achievements: We're excited to introduce a complete set of Steam achievements that will offer you additional challenges and goals to achieve during your adventure. You can find the entire list of new achievements here.

Bug Fixes: Our team has been tirelessly working to eliminate any bugs that might have affected the smoothness and enjoyment of your gameplay. Thanks to your reports, we have been able to identify and fix numerous issues, ensuring that your expedition will now be smoother and more seamless.

Database UI: A major addition is the implementation of the Database UI - a user interface for the game's lore, displaying various reports, orders, and more. This tool will significantly improve your ability to navigate the world of the game and aid in strategizing.

We know that many of you were looking forward to other features we had previously announced. We intended to include them in this update, but we decided that maintaining the promised regularity of updates is our priority. We believe that this decision will allow for better game balancing and provide you, the players, with a more stable and satisfying experience.

What's Next? Over the next few days, we plan to add the remaining fixes and enhancements. These will be implemented as soon as they are thoroughly prepared and tested. Our goal is to ensure that every aspect of "SCP: The Expedition" is as perfect as possible for our gaming community.

For now, we wish you happy achievement hunting and unforgettable adventures in the SCP world. Your support and passion are our constant inspiration to continue working and improving "SCP: The Expedition".

LUXO Interactive

-LUXO Interactive

notes.title: SCP: The Expedition Early Access Release: Summary and Future Directions
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/82a8d6e78ca09cc26e8df0ca0e71e82b2182dcd8.png

Dear gaming community,

We are thrilled to announce that "SCP: The Expedition" has finally seen the light of day. After many months of relentless work, and paying attention to every detail, the moment has come to share the fruits of our labor with you. The game is now on sale, and we eagerly await your feedback and are ready to implement further improvements.

However, we must openly admit that the significant interest surge in the days leading up to the launch did not translate into the sales we anticipated. The results fall far short of our expectations and complicate the planning of future updates. A combination of circumstances and the immense competition on Steam meant our game did not gain sufficient visibility.

Furthermore, we understand that the game's concept did not fully meet the SCP fanbase's expectations. Our goal was to create a unique gameplay experience focused on the conflict with the Chaos Insurgency, which, unfortunately, was not as well received as we had hoped. We understand your disappointment and appreciate all forms of feedback.

The project "SCP: The Expedition" was our most ambitious vision to date. We have never before undertaken such an advanced project. Despite our passion and best efforts, we were unable to realize all of our ideas. Nevertheless, we are incredibly proud of the work we have done and the experience we have gained. For most of the project's duration, merely two people worked tirelessly to face new challenges. Our team was supported by a community manager who relieved us from the duties of moderating Discord and preparing graphics and trailers.

In light of these challenges, our funds are dwindling, forcing us to seek additional sources of income. This will inevitably slow down the game's development, but we want to assure you: we are not giving up. We are committed to completing this project and delivering a full version of the game that meets your expectations.

To achieve this, we need your help. We have created a survey to collect essential information from our players. Your feedback is invaluable to us and will help us develop a strategy to make "SCP: The Expedition" a better product. We encourage you to participate in the survey and help shape the future of the game.

Survey link: SCP: The Expedition - Early Access Feedback Survey

Thank you for your support and patience. Together, we can create something extraordinary.

Best regards,
The LUXO Interactive Team

notes.title: What's New in SCP: The Expedition - Demo Update
notes.notes:
What's New in SCP: The Expedition - Demo Update
v0.1.2:24

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/3c0651171017ec36e3ff68565807dea0048a457a.png

We've been hard at work making "SCP: The Expedition" an even more immersive and engaging experience for all our brave explorers. Here's a glimpse of the major enhancements you'll find in the latest demo update:

Expanded Playable Area: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/26453a01a41d5e660e712bea503c86c932e5c22e.png
Venture further into the unknown with an extended map. Discover new secrets, face new challenges, and uncover more of what lies beyond.

Cover System: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/cd00ea2450597a7fbfe29e952d2db17080105645.png
Take strategic advantage in combat with the new cover system, allowing agents to duck behind obstacles for protection.

Vegetation Shaders and Camera Obstacle Avoidance: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/254215b8ddcba37aaeb0e4a0f053680dae54c76b.jpg
Never lose sight of your agents again, thanks to our new shaders that gently dissolve foliage that would otherwise block your view. Moreover, our camera now smartly navigates around obstructions, ensuring you have the best view of the action at all times.

New Story Elements: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/4664e5589ef515f119ae073c776b4bdb8be2575c.jpg
Engage with fresh narrative content, including a new character, deeper dialogues, and a trove of collectibles to enrich your journey.

Main Menu & Expedition Prep UI: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/904ccb3cebc394ee72991686d73c4855bbaf518d.jpg
Dive into a more intuitive start to your adventures with our improved main menu and expedition setup screens.

Inventory UI Redesign: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/c3c15481c37aa7ab4fec287ea2ae8f5e345fc94c.jpg
Managing your gear is smoother than ever with our overhauled inventory interface – sleek and easy to navigate.

And that's just the beginning! We've also implemented a series of optimizations and enhancements across the demo.

New Additions:

 New battles to challenge your tactical skills
 A new type of pickable object: scrap 
 New collectibles scattered throughout the game for you to discover
 New story elements, including a character that deepens the plot
 New tutorials to better acquaint you with game mechanics


Enhancements:

 Improved Red Lake's surface visuals for a more realistic environment
 Optimized game files for smoother performance and faster load times
 Enhanced protection of expedition areas to maintain gameplay balance
 Improved various UI elements for clearer and more intuitive interaction
 Improved dialogue display to ensure better storytelling immersion
 Upgraded the weapons system for more engaging combat experiences
 Improved enemy AI system for smarter and more challenging opponents
 Enhanced character and NPC animations for more lifelike movements
 Improved briefing UI with options for transcription and video skipping


Changes:

 Updated the exploration soundtrack to enhance the atmospheric feel
 Redesigned cursor hint UI for better gameplay guidance
 Changed the game logo for a fresh and updated look


Fixes:

 Fixed agents' avoidance issues to prevent them from blocking each other
 Fixed interaction UI issues to ensure a seamless experience
 Fixed the issue with highlighting agents/enemies 
 Rebalanced enemies' HP for a fairer combat difficulty
 Fixed the issue with during skipping dialogues


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/81cf49b9e79992f9c2a685f24952c28bdddde3c5.jpg
We're thrilled to roll out these updates and can't wait for you to dive back into the world of "SCP: The Expedition." As always, your feedback is invaluable, so keep it coming as we continue to shape the game!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/5aba8b9d66a764e0ee5cf362d973029091991ed0.png
Join us on our journey and become a crucial part of "SCP: The Expedition" development. Your support on Patreon helps us bring more content, features, and polish to the game. Become a patron today and gain access to exclusive updates, behind-the-scenes looks, and a chance to be involved in the game's creation. Your involvement makes all the difference. Support us at patreon.com and let's craft an unforgettable experience together!
